name: 53226 · Wauwatosa, WI
findings: ZIP 53226 (Wauwatosa) has 171 nonprofit organizations. 77 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 64 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53226 (Wauwatosa) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53226 (Wauwatosa) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
